models.name: McpTool
doc: Describes a single MCP tool returned by the server.

components.name: name
components.doc: name of the tool

components.name: description
components.doc: optional description of the tool

components.name: inputSchema
components.doc: JSON Schema describing the tool's accepted arguments

models.name: McpResourceTemplate
doc: Describes a single MCP resource template returned by the server.

components.name: uriTemplate
components.doc: URI template, e.g. {@code "file:///data/{path}"}

components.name: name
components.doc: human-readable name of the template

components.name: description
components.doc: optional description of the template

components.name: mimeType
components.doc: MIME type of the template content, when known (may be {@code null})

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON definition as returned by the server

components.name: mimeType

models.name: McpPrompt
doc: Describes a single MCP prompt returned by the server.

components.name: name
components.doc: name of the prompt

components.name: description
components.doc: optional description of the prompt

components.name: arguments
components.doc: arguments accepted by the prompt template

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON definition as returned by the server

nested.name: PromptArgument
doc: Describes a single argument accepted by a prompt template.

components.name: name
components.doc: name of the argument

components.name: description
components.doc: optional description of the argument

components.name: required
components.doc: whether the argument must be provided

models.name: McpToolResult
doc: Result returned after invoking an MCP tool.

components.name: content
components.doc: list of content items returned by the tool

components.name: isError
components.doc: whether the tool reported an error

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON result as returned by the server

methods.name: assertSuccess
methods.doc: Asserts that the tool did not report an error.
body: throw new AssertionError("Expected tool result to succeed but isError=true. Content: " + content);

methods.name: assertError
methods.doc: Asserts that the tool reported an error.
body: throw new AssertionError("Expected tool result to be an error but isError=false.");

methods.name: assertTextContains
methods.doc: Asserts that {@link #firstText()} contains the given substring.

params.name: expected
params.doc: substring expected in the first text content item

methods.throwsDoc: @throws AssertionError if the text does not contain the substring
body: "Expected tool result text to contain '" + expected + "' but was: '" + text + "'");

methods.name: firstText
methods.doc: Convenience method returning the text of the first text content item, or an empty string if none is present.

nested.name: ContentItem
doc: A single content item within a tool result.

components.name: type
components.doc: type of the content item, e.g. {@code "text"}

components.name: text
components.doc: text content of the item

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON item as returned by the server

models.name: McpResourceContent
doc: Content returned after reading an MCP resource.

components.name: uri
components.doc: URI of the resource that was read

components.name: contents
components.doc: list of content items returned by the server

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON result as returned by the server

methods.name: assertNotEmpty
methods.doc: Asserts that the resource content is not empty.
methods.throwsDoc: @throws AssertionError if no content items are present
body: throw new AssertionError("Expected resource content for '" + uri + "' to be non-empty.");

methods.name: assertTextContains
methods.doc: Asserts that {@link #firstText()} contains the given substring.

params.name: expected
params.doc: substring expected in the first text content item

methods.throwsDoc: @throws AssertionError if the text does not contain the substring
body: "Expected resource content for '" + uri + "' to contain '" + expected

methods.name: firstText
methods.doc: Convenience method returning the text of the first text content item, or an empty string if none is present.

nested.name: ContentItem
doc: A single content item within a resource read response.

components.name: uri
components.doc: URI of the resource the item belongs to

components.name: mimeType
components.doc: MIME type of the item content, when known (may be {@code null})

components.name: text
components.doc: text content of the item

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON item as returned by the server

models.name: McpPromptResult
doc: The rendered result of retrieving an MCP prompt by name.

components.name: description
components.doc: optional description of the prompt result

components.name: messages
components.doc: list of messages in the rendered prompt

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON result as returned by the server

methods.name: assertNotEmpty
methods.doc: Asserts that the prompt result contains at least one message.
methods.throwsDoc: @throws AssertionError if no messages are present
body: throw new AssertionError("Expected prompt result to contain messages but it was empty.");

methods.name: assertUserTextContains
methods.doc: Asserts that {@link #firstUserText()} contains the given substring.

params.name: expected
params.doc: substring expected in the first user message

methods.throwsDoc: @throws AssertionError if the text does not contain the substring
body: "Expected prompt user text to contain '" + expected + "' but was: '" + text + "'");

methods.name: firstUserText
methods.doc: Convenience method returning the text of the first user message, or an empty string if none is present.

nested.name: PromptMessage
doc: A single message within a prompt result.

components.name: role
components.doc: role of the message, e.g. {@code "user"} or {@code "assistant"}

components.name: text
components.doc: text content of the message

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON message as returned by the server

models.name: McpExchangeSummary
doc: A user-facing summary of a single JSON-RPC request/response exchange.
Hides the internal {@code RpcExchange} type from library consumers.

components.name: id
components.doc: unique identifier of the exchange

components.name: method
components.doc: JSON-RPC method that was invoked

components.name: status
components.doc: outcome of the exchange

components.name: latency
components.doc: round-trip duration, when recorded (may be {@code null})

components.name: errorDetail
components.doc: human-readable error description, when the exchange failed (may be {@code null})

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.doc: Returns {@code true} if the exchange completed successfully.

models.name: McpCompletion
doc: Result of an MCP {@code completion/complete} request.

components.name: values
components.doc: suggested completions

components.name: total
components.doc: total number of completion options, when known (may be {@code null})

components.name: hasMore
components.doc: whether there are additional completions beyond those listed

methods.name: hasSuggestions
methods.doc: Returns {@code true} if this completion carries at least one suggestion.

models.name: McpServerInfo
doc: Typed view of the server information returned during the MCP initialize handshake.

components.name: name
components.doc: server name reported during initialization

components.name: version
components.doc: server version reported during initialization

components.name: protocolVersion
components.doc: MCP protocol version negotiated during initialization

components.name: supportedCapabilities
components.doc: set of capability names advertised by the server

components.name: raw
components.doc: raw JSON initialize result as returned by the server

compactConstructor: supportedCapabilities == null ? new HashSet<>() : new HashSet<>(supportedCapabilities));

methods.name: supportsCapability
methods.doc: Returns {@code true} if the server advertises the given capability.
methods.returns: whether the capability is present in {@link #supportedCapabilities()}

methods.name: supportsTools
methods.doc: Returns {@code true} if the server advertises the {@code "tools"} capability.

methods.name: supportsResources
methods.doc: Returns {@code true} if the server advertises the {@code "resources"} capability.

methods.name: supportsPrompts
methods.doc: Returns {@code true} if the server advertises the {@code "prompts"} capability.
